svg.title: The day the letters went up
svg.desc: A campus with a new research wing under scaffolding, letters of a sponsor name going up, a photographer, a press release on a noticeboard and a sign still showing the old name.

g.text: The day the letters went up
Twelve things to find. Four are what the agreement says. Four are what people think it says.
the new wing, a name going up
the meeting room, a long table
communications, two days to write it
the lobby, a model under glass
two workers on a scaffold, fitting letters
the press release, on a noticeboard
the lawyer, who read all nine pages
a researcher carrying a box out
